document_zh: 三种未来情景矩阵：不变量、可变项与退出条件
document_en: A matrix of three futures: invariants, adjustable components and exit conditions

statement_zh: 本文件不预测未来，也不评价任何辖区的现行或未来政策。三条分岔是压力测试的加载方向，用途是回答同一个问题：若外部世界这样变化，本方案哪一部分不动、哪一部分调整、什么时候整体退出。
统一禁令一条：情景是调整构件的依据，不是调整判据的依据。三条分岔中的任何一条都不得被用作放宽判据、降低阈值或延长宽限的理由。
退出不等于成果归零。任一情景下的整体退出都有既定形态：撤除 AI 层、保留留城资产、把服务等价基准以既已生效的许可留在公共域。
本文件不新增指标，不产生任何数值；全部条款要么指向包内既有条款，要么在条目内标注为本文件新增。
statement_en: This file forecasts nothing and passes no judgement on any jurisdiction's policy, present or future. The three branches are directions of load in a stress test, put there to answer one question: if the outside world moves this way, which part of the proposal holds, which part adjusts, and when does the whole thing withdraw.

One prohibition runs across all three: a scenario is grounds for adjusting components, never for adjusting criteria. None of the three may be cited to relax a criterion, lower a threshold or extend a grace period.

Withdrawal is not the same as losing everything. A whole-scheme exit under any scenario has a settled shape: the AI layer comes down, the assets left to the city stay, and the service-equivalence baseline remains in the public domain under the licence already in force.
No metric is added and no value produced here; every clause either points to one already in the package or is marked in place as new to this file.
declaration.invariant_source_rule_zh: 不变量原则上不是本文件新设的：每一条都注明来源条款。确有新增者（IV-1-4 一条）在条目内明示为本文件新增判据，须按版本治理登记，不得混入既有条款。
declaration.invariant_source_rule_en: As a rule the invariants are not new here: each cites the clause it comes from. Where one is genuinely new — IV-1-4 alone — the entry says so in place, and it must be registered under version governance rather than blended into the existing clauses.
declaration.judgeability_declaration_zh: 本文件的全部退出条件分两类，逐条以 judgeability 字段标注：immediate（即时可判）指仅凭书面事实、字段取值或声明本身即可判定，不依赖现场读数与预注册阈值——底线某项被声明为可削减、许可被书面拒绝、人工接管角色字段能否合规填写均属此类；pre_registered（须预注册后可判）指须先由三方复核组在测试前书面预注册口径与阈值、再以现场读数判定。三条分岔各至少含一条 immediate 条件：本包当前无任何阈值已预注册、六项审计读数全部为零值，若退出条件全部依赖读数，退出机制在当前状态下将不可触发，而一个不可触发的退出机制等于没有退出机制。条件状态另以 status 标注：unknown 指条件可判而事实尚未发生；not_yet_measurable 指阈值未预注册且读数为零值，当前不可判。
declaration.judgeability_declaration_en: Every exit condition here falls into one of two classes, marked on each entry by the judgeability field. Immediate means it can be settled on a written fact, a field value or a declaration alone, without any site reading or pre-registered threshold: a floor item declared reducible, a permission refused in writing, or whether the human-takeover role field can be filled compliantly. Pre-registered means the three-party review must first register the definition and threshold in writing before measurement, and the reading then settles it. Each of the three branches carries at least one immediate condition: no threshold in this package is pre-registered and the six audit readings all stand at zero, so if every exit condition turned on a reading the exit mechanism could not fire at all in the present state — and an exit that cannot fire is no exit. Status is marked separately: unknown means the condition can be judged but the fact has not yet occurred; not_yet_measurable means no threshold is pre-registered and the reading is zero, so it cannot be judged today.

scenarios.divergence_zh: 通用模型能力持续提升、单位成本趋近于零，AI 界面成为默认且几乎免费；本方案隐含的「AI 层是增量成本」这一前提不再成立。
scenarios.divergence_en: General model capability keeps rising and unit cost approaches zero, so an AI interface becomes the default and costs almost nothing; the assumption implicit in this proposal, that the AI layer is an added cost, no longer holds.
scenarios.why_sharp_zh: 威胁不是技术失败而是论证失败。当 AI 通道几乎免费、人工通道是唯一有边际成本的一侧，「使用率太低」会被用来论证削减人工窗口——本方案在这一情景下第一次面对的不是反对者，而是一套看上去无可指摘的效率论证。
scenarios.why_sharp_en: The threat is not technical failure but argumentative defeat. When the AI channel is nearly free and the staffed channel is the only side carrying a marginal cost, low usage becomes the argument for cutting the staffed window. Here the proposal meets, for the first time, not an opponent but an efficiency argument that looks unanswerable.

invariants.zh: 非 AI 通道底线的三项承诺——可见性、值守、预算——任一项不得声明为可削减。
invariants.en: None of the three non-AI channel floor commitments — visibility, staffing, budget — may be declared reducible.

invariants.zh: 服务桌四位序不可调换，人工窗口先于一切 AI 构件设立，退出回执位在最后一步之后仍然在场。
invariants.en: The desk's four stations may not be rearranged: the staffed window comes before any AI component and the exit-receipt station remains present after the last step.

invariants.zh: 五项对人的处分性决定为人工专属，不因 AI 更便宜、更快或更准而移交。
invariants.en: The five dispositive decisions about people stay human-only, and cheaper, faster or more accurate AI does not transfer them.

invariants.zh: 使用率不进入任何判据的分子或分母。本条为本文件新增判据：既有基准从未以使用人次为条件，因此「没人用」在本基准内不构成任何一项的停止、降级或削减理由；欲以使用率为由削减底线者，须先修改基准并按版本治理提交失败样本与复算说明。
invariants.en: Usage counts enter no numerator and no denominator. This criterion is new to this file: the baseline has never conditioned anything on visitor numbers, so nobody using it is no ground for stopping, downgrading or cutting anything. Anyone wishing to cut the floor on usage grounds must first amend the baseline and file the failed samples and recalculation note version governance requires.

adjustable_components.zh: AI 开关的物理形态可调（默认关闭或默认开启加一键关闭），四位序次序不变。
adjustable_components.en: The physical form of the AI switch may change — default off, or default on with one-touch off — while the order of the four stations does not.

adjustable_components.zh: 场景卡的数量与优先级可调；卡的数量本就不构成需求覆盖度。
adjustable_components.en: The number and priority of scenario cards may change; card count has never stood for demand coverage.

adjustable_components.zh: L4b 复审到期日的长度可调，但常态运行不默认永久这一性质不变；续期须给出正向理由这一既有条款同样不变——等价决定进入，公共增益决定保留，AI 层变便宜不是公共增益，因此不构成续期理由。
adjustable_components.en: The length of the L4b review-due period may change, but continuous operation still does not default to permanent, and the existing clause requiring a positive reason for renewal is likewise unchanged: equivalence decides entry and public gain decides retention, and an AI layer becoming cheaper is not a public gain and therefore not a reason to renew.

adjustable_components.zh: 关闭态路径拒绝词表可随新的「同一系统入口」形态扩充，扩充即版本递增。
adjustable_components.en: The forbidden-target list for the AI-off route may grow as new shapes of the same-system door appear; each extension bumps the version.

trigger_conditions.zh: 非 AI 通道底线任一项被改为可削减（non_ai_channel_floor 字段取值判定，属声明性事实），且三方复核确认无法恢复。单点触发即该点位停止；全线均如此时，本方案的核心命题在该辖区已不成立。
trigger_conditions.en: Any floor item is made reducible — settled on the value of the non_ai_channel_floor field, a declared fact — and the three-party review finds it cannot be restored. One node triggers a stop at that node; where it holds along the whole line, the proposal's core claim no longer stands in that jurisdiction.

trigger_conditions.zh: 以使用率为由的削减未经修改基准即被执行。该情形凭削减决定的书面理由即可判定，不需要任何使用率数值——按 IV-1-4，使用率本就不进入任何判据的分子或分母，因此举出数字与举不出数字在本条下同样构成违例。
trigger_conditions.en: A cut argued on usage grounds is carried out without amending the baseline first. The written reason for the cut settles this and no usage figure is needed: under IV-1-4 usage counts enter no numerator and no denominator, so producing a number and failing to produce one are equally a violation here.

exit_condition.who_decides_zh: 三方复核组，未参与制作的独立专业人员与参与者代表在席。
exit_condition.who_decides_en: The three-party review, with independent professionals who did not build the thing and participant representatives seated.
exit_condition.what_survives_zh: 留城资产逐项保留（铸刻导视、触觉地图与触觉引导带、培训过的值守班组、多语言印刷品）；基准文本许可已即时生效且不因退出而回溯撤销。
exit_condition.what_survives_en: The assets left to the city stay item by item — cast signage, tactile maps and guide bands, a trained stewarding crew, multilingual print — and the baseline's text licence, already in force, is not retroactively withdrawn by an exit.

scenarios.divergence_zh: 对公共空间测试、具身智能运行、数据采集与跨主体共享的许可与合规要求收紧，限定开放测试的门槛显著上升。
scenarios.divergence_en: Permission and compliance requirements tighten around testing in public space, embodied-AI operation, data collection and sharing between parties, and the bar for bounded-open testing rises markedly.
scenarios.why_sharp_zh: 本方案的全部证据产自分级开放，一旦限定开放不可得，「以证据换期限」的机制失去输出端；本方案自身的零授权现场验证计划同样可能落入更严的管理要求，而该计划已自设「存在不确定时不执行」。这一条分岔检验的是：证据链断在最上游时，本方案是否仍诚实。
scenarios.why_sharp_en: All the evidence here is produced by graduated opening, so once bounded opening is unavailable the mechanism of trading evidence for tenure loses its outlet. The zero-permission field verification plan may itself fall under stricter rules, and that plan already binds itself not to run where anything is uncertain. This branch tests whether the proposal stays honest when the evidence chain is cut at its source.

invariants.zh: 四道闸门缺一不可，未通过 G3 不进入开放空间；门槛上升不改变闸门顺序，也不产生任何简化通道。
invariants.en: All four gates are required and nothing enters open space before G3; a higher bar changes neither the order of the gates nor opens any simplified route through them.
invariants.source: proposal.md#更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划

invariants.zh: 退出权先于服务权：退出方式对使用者可见且可执行这一条不随开放层级下移而放宽。
invariants.en: The right to leave comes before the right to be served: that an exit is visible and executable for the user is not relaxed as the opening level drops.
invariants.source: proposal.md#统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究

invariants.zh: 数据默认不采集身份、健康、障碍类别、位置与行为数据。收紧方向与本方案默认一致，因此本情景不修改任何数据条款。
invariants.en: By default no identity, health, impairment-category, location or behaviour data is collected. Tightening runs the same way as this default, so no data clause changes under this scenario.
invariants.source: proposal.md#八类要素保障：包容 AI 赛道的准入条件

adjustable_components.zh: 全部场景 × 点位的申报等级整体下移一级（L3 回 L2、L2 回 L1），按既有规则不附加额外程序门槛。
adjustable_components.en: Every scenario-by-node pair steps down one level, L3 to L2 and L2 to L1, with no extra procedural hurdle under the existing rule.

adjustable_components.zh: 涉及实机与路权的三张卡（服务机器人礼让、低速接驳、无人配送）优先暂停，规程停留在文本与仿真。
adjustable_components.en: The three cards involving real machines and right of way — robot yielding, low-speed shuttles, unmanned delivery — pause first, with their protocols left in text and simulation.

adjustable_components.zh: 零授权现场验证计划按其既定条款直接不执行，方法作为交付物保留。
adjustable_components.en: The zero-permission field verification plan simply does not run, under the clause it already carries, and the method remains as a deliverable.

adjustable_components.zh: 区域协同按各行既有的未获授权退出规则单方执行，方法学以匿名化公开版本单向发布。
adjustable_components.en: Regional collaboration follows the no-authorisation exit rule already written on each row, and the methodology is published one-way in anonymised form.

trigger_conditions.zh: 可逆原型层亦不获许可，且方法学的公开发布同样受限——即证据既不能产生也不能流通。两项均凭书面许可决定判定，不依赖任何读数与阈值。
trigger_conditions.en: Even the reversible-prototype level is refused permission and publishing the methodology is likewise restricted, so evidence can neither be produced nor circulated. Both halves are settled on written permission decisions and turn on no reading or threshold.

trigger_conditions.zh: 为取得许可而被要求删除、弱化或附条件保留四道闸门中的任一道，或被要求开设一条绕过 G3 的简化通道。按 IV-2-1 这一要求不可接受，接受即退出，因此该条的判定对象是要求本身而不是任何实测结果。
trigger_conditions.en: Removing, weakening or conditionally retaining any of the four gates is required in order to obtain permission, or a simplified route around G3 is required. Under IV-2-1 such a requirement is not acceptable and accepting it is the exit, so what is judged here is the requirement itself and not any measured result.

exit_condition.who_decides_zh: 未来经授权的主体依当地合规确认作出；本方案不代任何一方判断合规，也不评价任何监管安排。
exit_condition.who_decides_en: A future authorised body decides on its own compliance confirmation; this proposal judges compliance for no one and passes no comment on any regulatory arrangement.
exit_condition.what_survives_zh: 退出实施层，保留包内全部登记与基准文本许可；本方案的空间与制度结论仍可被任何主体逐项复核，这一点不依赖任何许可。
exit_condition.what_survives_en: Implementation withdraws while every registration in the package and the baseline's text licence remain; the spatial and institutional conclusions stay checkable item by item by anyone, and that does not depend on any permission.

scenarios.name_en: A shortage of people to staff the service
scenarios.divergence_zh: 值守、维护与人工窗口岗位的招募与留任持续困难，人力科目的成本上升快于其他科目。
scenarios.divergence_en: Recruiting and keeping people for stewarding, maintenance and the staffed window stays difficult, and the labour account rises faster than the others.
scenarios.why_sharp_zh: 本方案把最不可削减的一项押在最短缺的一种资源上——这是方案自身结构里最脆的一处，而不是外部世界的问题。它与 AI 廉价普及情景的区别在于：那一条是有人而被论证掉，这一条是想留也留不住，因此不能靠坚持判据解决。
scenarios.why_sharp_en: The proposal stakes the item it least allows to be cut on the resource in shortest supply. This is the weakest point in its own structure rather than a fact about the world outside. It differs from the cheap-AI branch in that there people exist and are argued away, whereas here they cannot be kept at all — so holding the line on criteria does not by itself solve it.

invariants.zh: 不得以 AI 提效为名削减值守班次，不得把接管压力与 AI 层运维成本转嫁为一线值守者的无偿加班；转嫁即触发停止条件。
invariants.en: Shifts may not be cut in the name of AI efficiency, and neither takeover load nor the AI layer's running cost may be passed down as unpaid overtime for front-line stewards; passing it down triggers the stop condition.

invariants.zh: 双联交接台账不因人手紧张而简化：交出方与接收方须为不同角色并各自署名，拒收与暂缓须写明理由且上一责任方继续在岗。
invariants.en: The duplicate handover ledger is not simplified because hands are short: handing-over and receiving roles differ and each signs, and a refusal or hold states its reason while the previous accountable party stays on duty.

invariants.zh: 值守与维护人员是第四类保障对象：接管耗时与响应记录只用于评价系统与流程，不用于评价个人。
invariants.en: Stewards and maintainers are the fourth protected group: takeover times and response records assess the system and the process, never the individual.
invariants.source: proposal.md#更新过程本身的公共利益

adjustable_components.zh: 值守形态可由常驻改为呼叫响应，服务等级时限可延长，但延长值须公示并进入年度公开报告的开放时长与故障恢复两个字段。
adjustable_components.en: Stewarding may move from a permanent post to call-and-respond and the service-level times may lengthen, provided the new values are published and enter the annual report's opening-hours and fault-and-recovery fields.

adjustable_components.zh: 开放时长可缩短，但缩短即公布口径，不得只减不报。
adjustable_components.en: Opening hours may shorten, provided the definition is published with them; they may not be cut unreported.

adjustable_components.zh: 承载服务桌与值守的节点数可收缩到子集，收缩按点位降级执行，不附加额外程序门槛，也不触发整包回退。
adjustable_components.en: The set of nodes carrying the desk and the stewarding may shrink; shrinkage is executed as a node-level downgrade with no extra hurdle and no package-wide rollback.

adjustable_components.zh: 四层运营节律的频次可下调，唯一产出仍是可复核证据与公开回执。
adjustable_components.en: The four-tier operating rhythm may run less often, its only output still being checkable evidence and public receipts.

trigger_conditions.zh: 维持底线的唯一办法是让一线值守者无偿加班。该情形凭排班表与劳务安排即可判定，不依赖读数：按 R-04 的既有停止阈值，转嫁本身即触发停止条件。正确动作不是降低判据，而是关闭该点位的 AI 层保留服务（G3 四选一的第四项），或整体退出该点位。
trigger_conditions.en: The only way to hold the floor is unpaid overtime for front-line stewards. The rota and the employment arrangements settle this and no reading is involved: under the stop threshold already set in R-04, passing the load down is itself what fires the stop. The right move is not to lower the criterion but to close the AI layer and keep the service — the fourth of the four G3 outcomes — or to withdraw from that node.

trigger_conditions.zh: 整体退出的判据：全线无法为任何一个节点填出一个可被找到的值守岗位，即人工接管角色字段在十节点上均无法合规填写。该条为字段填写判定，不涉阈值。
trigger_conditions.en: The whole-line exit: no node can name a findable stewarding post, that is, the human-takeover role field cannot be filled compliantly at any of the ten. This is settled on whether the field can be filled and turns on no threshold.

exit_condition.who_decides_zh: 运营方与维护方提出，三方复核组裁决；常设独立申诉官受理值守者一侧的申诉，其记录进入下一次 G3 必审材料。
exit_condition.who_decides_en: The operator and maintainer raise it and the three-party review rules; the standing independent appeals officer takes appeals from the stewards' side, and those records become mandatory exhibits at the next G3.
exit_condition.what_survives_zh: 留城资产中最重的一项恰在此处：培训过的值守班组。AI 层退出后，若班组仍在岗，服务不因此消失——这是本情景下唯一有意义的成果。
exit_condition.what_survives_en: The heaviest of the assets left to the city is exactly the one at issue: a trained stewarding crew. If the crew stays after the AI layer goes, the service does not vanish with it — and under this scenario that is the only outcome that matters.

cross_cutting_rules.criteria_lock_zh: 三条分岔共用一条禁令：情景可以改变构件、等级、频次与形态，不得改变判据、阈值与停止条件。任何以「情势变化」为由的判据修改，须走版本治理并提交失败样本与复算说明，与任何一次日常修订同等对待。
cross_cutting_rules.criteria_lock_en: One prohibition is shared by all three: a scenario may change components, levels, frequencies and forms, and may not change criteria, thresholds or stop conditions. Any amendment of a criterion on the grounds that circumstances changed goes through version governance with failed samples and a recalculation note, exactly as any routine revision would.
cross_cutting_rules.combination_rule_zh: 三条分岔可同时发生，且两两组合的最严条件优先：例如 AI 廉价普及与劳动力短缺同时出现时，「使用率不入判据」与「不得转嫁无偿加班」两条同时适用，不得互相抵消。
cross_cutting_rules.combination_rule_en: The branches may occur together and the strictest condition of any pair prevails: where cheap AI and a labour shortage arrive at once, the rule that usage counts stay out of the criteria and the rule against passing costs down as unpaid overtime both apply and neither cancels the other.
cross_cutting_rules.exit_shape_zh: 退出的形态在三条分岔中相同：撤 AI 层、留非 AI 通道与留城资产、基准文本许可不回溯撤销。退出须留下一份带否定结论的记录与一份变更回执，那份记录本身是成果而不是失败。
cross_cutting_rules.exit_shape_en: The shape of an exit is the same in all three: the AI layer comes down, the non-AI channels and the assets left to the city stay, and the baseline's text licence is not retroactively withdrawn. An exit leaves a record carrying a negative conclusion and a change receipt, and that record is itself an outcome rather than a failure.

excluded_branches.why_not_selected_zh: 已由雨天断点与夜间断点两项审计读数、蓝绿与雨洪章的类型判据处理，属运维与设计条件而非对判据的压力方向；收录会把已被处理的事项重报一遍。
excluded_branches.why_not_selected_en: Already handled by the wet-weather and night-break audit readings and by the type criteria in the blue-green and stormwater section; it is an operating and design condition rather than a direction of load on the criteria, and including it would re-report what is already handled.

excluded_branches.why_not_selected_zh: 该方向与本方案的判据同向：它增加对人工通道与易读流程的需求，而不是压迫它们。把顺风写进压力测试，会让矩阵变成自我恭维。
excluded_branches.why_not_selected_en: It runs the same way as the criteria here, increasing demand for staffed channels and easy-read processes rather than pressing on them. Writing a tailwind into a stress test would turn the matrix into self-congratulation.

excluded_branches.why_not_selected_zh: 本包没有权属、租金与地价资料，任何分岔设定都只能由虚构参数支撑；按既有纪律，登记为 unknown 优于编造一条看起来完整的分岔。
excluded_branches.why_not_selected_en: The package holds no tenure, rent or land-value data, so any branch would rest on invented parameters. Under the discipline already in force, registering it as unknown is better than fabricating a branch that looks complete.

limitations_zh: 本文件不是政策预测、风险评估报告或应急预案，也不构成对任何辖区法规现状与走向的判断。
三条分岔的选取本身是设计判断，可被替换；替换须给出理由并保留被替换分岔的登记。
本文件不产生任何指标数值，也不改变任何既有指标的口径。
全部条款除明示为本文件新增者外，均指向包内既有条款，不新设治理程序。
limitations_en: This is not a policy forecast, a risk assessment or an emergency plan, and it judges neither the state nor the direction of any jurisdiction's rules.
The choice of the three branches is itself a design judgement and may be replaced; a replacement states its reasons and keeps the register of what it replaced.
No metric value is produced here and no existing metric definition is changed.
Except where an entry says otherwise, every clause points to one already in the package and no new governance procedure is created.
